models.python_snippet:
from PIL import Image
import torch
from transformers import AutoProcessor, AutoModelForImageTextToText

model_id = "lighteternal/tissuedecision-9b"
processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(model_id)
model = AutoModelForImageTextToText.from_pretrained(
    model_id, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map="auto"
)

img = Image.open("rat_liver_roi.png").convert("RGB")
prompt = (
    "Organ: Rat Liver (H&E). Assess for treatment-related findings.\n"
    "Choices: A) Normal hepatic parenchyma  B) Centrilobular hepatocellular necrosis  "
    "C) Periportal bile duct hyperplasia  D) Diffuse microvesicular steatosis"
)
messages = [{"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "image", "image": img}, {"type": "text", "text": prompt}]}]
inputs = processor.apply_chat_template(messages, add_generation_prompt=True, tokenize=True, return_dict=True, return_tensors="pt").to(model.device)
out = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=256, do_sample=False)
print(processor.decode(out[0][inputs['input_ids'].shape[-1]:], skip_special_tokens=True))

from conch.open_clip_custom import create_model_from_pretrained, tokenize, get_tokenizer
from PIL import Image
import torch

model, preprocess = create_model_from_pretrained('conch_ViT-B-16', 'hf_hub:mahmoodlab/CONCH')
model.eval().cuda()
prompts = ["normal hepatic parenchyma", "centrilobular coagulative necrosis", "macrovesicular steatosis", "portal fibrosis"]
tokens = tokenize(texts=prompts, tokenizer=get_tokenizer()).cuda()
img = preprocess(Image.open("rat_liver.png")).unsqueeze(0).cuda()
with torch.inference_mode():
    probs = (model.encode_image(img) @ model.encode_text(tokens).T * model.logit_scale.exp()).softmax(dim=-1)
print(dict(zip(prompts, probs[0].tolist())))
